title: Remote UE Report initiated by the UE

entities.name: Remote UE Report procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to report information about newly connected or disconnected remote UEs to the network.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to initiate the Remote UE Report procedure.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE in response to the REMOTE UE REPORT message.

entities.name: Remote UE information
entities.description: Information about newly connected or disconnected remote UEs included in the REMOTE UE REPORT message.

entities.name: Encrypted IMSI remote UE identity
entities.description: Encrypted IMSI identity of a remote UE included in the REMOTE UE REPORT message.

entities.name: ProSe Key Management Function address
entities.description: Address of the ProSe Key Management Function corresponding to an encrypted IMSI remote UE identity.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identity of the default EPS bearer associated with the PDN connection for the remote UE.

entities.name: T3493
entities.description: Timer started by the UE when sending the REMOTE UE REPORT message and stopped upon receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State entered by the UE after sending the REMOTE UE REPORT message and starting timer T3493.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by the UE after receiving the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message and stopping timer T3493.

entities.name: Encrypted IMSI present
entities.description: Condition that if any encrypted IMSI remote UE identity is included in the REMOTE UE REPORT message, the UE shall include the corresponding ProSe Key Management Function address.

relations.description: The Remote UE Report procedure is initiated by sending the REMOTE UE REPORT message.
The REMOTE UE REPORT message contains information about newly connected or disconnected remote UEs.
The REMOTE UE REPORT message contains the default EPS bearer identity of the PDN connection associated with the remote UE.
The REMOTE UE REPORT message may contain encrypted IMSI remote UE identities.
If encrypted IMSI is present, the UE shall include the corresponding ProSe Key Management Function address.
Sending the REMOTE UE REPORT message starts timer T3493.
After sending the REMOTE UE REPORT message, the UE enters the PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.
Receiving the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message stops timer T3493.
After receiving the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message, the UE enters the PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
